metadata.title: FlavorWheel México - Styling Conflict Analysis
metadata.purpose: Comprehensive analysis of styling inconsistencies between pages using fx-design system vs manual Tailwind utilities
metadata.scope: Complete application styling conflict analysis with migration recommendations
metadata.severity: CRITICAL - Inconsistent user experience across pages
metadata.primary_issue: Landing page uses blue gradients while authenticated pages use fx-design brown/beige system

fx_design_system.description: Comprehensive design system defined in globals.css with CSS custom properties
fx_design_system.usage: Used extensively in authenticated pages (create/study, dashboard, profile, etc.)

manual_tailwind_system.description: Ad-hoc Tailwind utility classes without design system tokens

colors.background: Various gradients (blue-50 to indigo-100, amber-50 to amber-100)

manual_tailwind_system.coverage: Used in landing page and some component overrides
manual_tailwind_system.usage: Limited to landing page and occasional component overrides

conflict_impact.user_experience: HIGH - Jarring visual transition from landing to authenticated pages
conflict_impact.brand_consistency: LOW - Two different color palettes and design languages
conflict_impact.maintainability: POOR - Multiple competing systems increase complexity
conflict_impact.accessibility: CONCERN - Different contrast ratios and color usage patterns

landing_page.conflict_with_fx_system: COMPLETE - Uses entirely different color palette
landing_page.user_impact: HIGH - First impression doesn't match app experience

issues: But has some manual amber/orange colors in UnifiedDashboard
dashboard_page.conflict_with_fx_system: PARTIAL - AppShell uses fx-bg but content has manual colors
dashboard_page.status: IMPROVABLE - Could be fully fx-system compliant

profile_page.status: IMPROVABLE - Could be fully fx-system compliant

flavor_wheels_page.conflict_with_fx_system: PARTIAL - Consistent with other dashboard pages
flavor_wheels_page.status: IMPROVABLE - Could be fully fx-system compliant

root_landing_page.conflict_with_fx_system: COMPLETE - Same as dedicated landing page
root_landing_page.status: CRITICAL - Main entry point has wrong styling

tailwind_config_status.description: Tailwind config properly integrates fx-design tokens as semantic classes

globals_css_status.description: Comprehensive design system with primitives, semantic tokens, and component classes
features: CSS custom properties for all design tokens

component_system_status.description: UI components properly use Tailwind classes that map to fx-design tokens

priority_1_critical.action: Update landing page to use fx-design system
changes: Apply consistent spacing using fx-design tokens
priority_1_critical.impact: HIGH - Fixes main entry point inconsistency

changes: Replace manual amber/orange colors with fx-primary/fx-accent

component_patterns.button_components: Use fx-primary/fx-accent variants instead of manual colors
component_patterns.typography: Use font-heading and text-fx-text-primary for consistency

visual_regression: Transition from landing to authenticated pages

user_experience: Seamless visual transition from landing to authenticated pages
Consistent brand identity throughout the application
development: Single source of truth for design tokens
Easier theme updates and brand changes
accessibility: Consistent contrast ratios across all pages
performance: Reduced CSS bundle size (eliminate duplicate color definitions)

current_state_summary.business_impact: HIGH - Affects user onboarding and brand perception

immediate_next_steps: Start with landing page migration (highest impact)
Create a design system audit checklist
Document the fx-design token usage patterns
long_term_strategy: Add automated linting for design token usage
success_criteria: All pages use consistent fx-design color palette
Seamless visual transition between landing and authenticated pages
No manual Tailwind color classes in component code
